snippet.title: Age of Enlightenment - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist on Steam!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3091880/Age_of_Enlightenment/
(Work in Progress)

Age of Enlightenment is an upcoming Grand Strategy game set in 1700 and covering the entire world.
It features advanced political, population and economic simulations to provide an authentic and immersive experience.

My links:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3091880/Age_of_Enlightenment
https://discord.com/invite/ZZ54NPAnbX
https://www.patreon.com/ageofenlightenment

Credits:
Music:
The Four Seasons by Antonio Vivaldi
The Wichita State University Chamber Players; John Harrison (Violin), Robert Turizziani (Conductor)
